_: An example of a record for scripts/deploy-credit-desk.ts, on the chain the token record decides for the launch — Robinhood Chain, chain id 4663, the desk's own. Illustrative: no CURB token exists, so the token is nobody, the treasury is nobody, the pool is null, and reviewedBy is empty on purpose so the script refuses it. A real record is written after the token exists, with the token and the treasury read from the chain, reviewed by name, and kept beside the deployment it produced.
